newsitem.title: USA: J & J Snack settles sexual harassment suit.
newsitem.headline: J & J Snack settles sexual harassment suit.

text.p: J & J Snack Foods Corp said Monday it settled litigation brought on by a former employee alleging same-sex harassment by a company supervisor.
The company said in a release that the suit was settled for "an amount substantially less than the amount awarded by a jury earlier this month," but did not disclose a figure.
The company said it will recover its settlement costs in connection with this from its insurance carrier who failed to settle the case under policy limits.
The settlement and recovery, the company said, did not affect earnings. The company earlier said that "the verdict bears little relation to the facts or the damages presented."
Net earnings for the second quarter ended March 29, 1997, were up 45 percent to $906,000 compared to $625,000 last year.
Earnings per share for the quarter were up 43 percent to $0.10, based on 8,910,000 shares, from $0.07 per share, based on 9,101,000 shares last year, the company said.
